if: a document is issued under rule 49, rule 50, rule 51, rule 52 or rule 53
then: rule 54(2) and rule 54(4) apply to it, mutatis mutandis
note: So the banking-sector consolidated document and the passenger-transport ticket relaxations reach bills of supply, receipt vouchers, refund vouchers, payment vouchers and revised invoices too.

evidence.quote: The provisions of sub-rule (2) or sub-rule (4) shall apply, mutatis mutandis, to the documents issued under rule 49 or rule 50 or rule 51 or rule 52 or rule 53.
